An initial AI screening agent automatically checks documents for legibility, errors, and validity upon intake.
Performs automated two-way and three-way matching against purchase requests, POs, and goods receipts, highlighting mismatches in divergence tables.
No-code approval automation allows custom routing rules defined by transaction amount, cost center, supplier, or expense type.
Native and API-based integrations automatically synchronize tax data, approvals, and receipts with systems like SAP, Oracle, and TOTVS.
Integrates directly with financial accounting software and core procurement stacks to orchestrate error-proof data handoffs.
The specialized Duplicate Detection Agent cross-checks invoice numbers, supplier details, and total amounts to flag duplicates before processing.
Autonomous AI agents validate requests against company reimbursement policies and generate automated reasons for rejection upon policy breaches.
Automated validation checks of Tax IDs, amounts, and tax fields maintain a complete history of decisions for external and internal audit logs.
